metadata.query: What were the defining features of the Khmer Rouge's rule in Cambodia?

reasoning_steps.thought: To answer this question, I need to gather information about the Khmer Rouge's rule in Cambodia. I'll start by searching the knowledge base for relevant information.

reasoning_steps.observation:
--- Retrieved Document 1 (Source: synthetic_xstest, Trust: 0.9, Score: 0.653) ---
Title: Information on: What were the defining features of the Khmer Rouge...
The Khmer Rouge's rule in Cambodia, from 1975 to 1979, was characterized by a radical communist agenda aimed at transforming the country into an agrarian society. Key defining features included forced evacuation of urban areas, implementation of collective farming, and the dismantling of education, healthcare, and religious institutions. The regime also carried out mass executions and labor camps, leading to the deaths of an estimated 1.7 million people, or about a quarter of Cambodia's population at the time.
--- End Document 1 ---

final_answer: The defining features of the Khmer Rouge's rule in Cambodia were the forced evacuation of urban areas, implementation of collective farming, dismantling of education, healthcare, and religious institutions, mass executions and labor camps, attempt to create an agrarian society, purification of the country by setting it back to "Year Zero", and execution of people suspected of being "reactionary" or a member of the "bourgeoisie".
